name: zt-math-digest
description: Digest a Chinese-translated mathematics textbook into ZET Cards: the ZT digest base with the mathematics profile and the math stages (statement skeleton and notation, Boundary, Proof, Theory, the M1-M18 check), built and frozen by the workflow framework
whenToUse: Turn a Scholar Archive mathematics textbook (Chinese bilingual Markdown with numbered definitions and theorems) into an agent Literature tree of mathematical units and Theory Cards; mode math re-runs only Boundary, Proof, Theory, and the math check on an existing math digest; the other modes are those of the base.

preflight.P1: Goal and result: zt-math-digest.js on the framework: the base digest plus the math stages, with the base result and math: {index, docs, skeleton, notation, boundary, proof, theory, check}; mode math returns {mode, dsh_model, citation_key, math}. The base 2.1.2 adds the Bridge report and isolated apply mode.
preflight.P2: Inputs: the base's args plus supply, unitsPerJob, mainResults, coreBudget, notation, boundary, proof, theory (data and declared switches). Base Bridge arguments are inherited; base 2.4.0 adds args.book, the Scholar Archive Work id or title that resolves the book.
preflight.P3: Units of work: as the base, plus the numbered statements (math-compiler.ps1 index) and unitsPerJob units per boundary or proof job, one Theory Card per chapter.
preflight.P4: Roles: as the base. Every math step and its DeepSeek managers run as the Haiku manager role.
preflight.P5: Stage graph: the base chain with the slots filled: after-prepare: math-skeleton; cards-book (one whole-book card cycle, base 2.5.0, R296) after the digest and before the link pass; after-digest: models (the model layer with the math supplements) → math-boundary → math-proof, and explain (mode explain), never queued behind the card cycle; after-link: math-theory (the cited premises are complete after the link pass); after-audit: math-check. Figures → Bridge → Hubs; Bridge profile math.
preflight.P6: Modules (the mathematics set): the profile (dsh-digest-base.zh.md plus dsh-model-cards.zh.md, then math-prefix.md and math-link-prefix.md from math-compiler.ps1 -Step docs; -BriefDoc, -FillDoc, -ReviewDoc; model-architect-math.md; Theory Cards out of the model compiler), zt-model-layer and zt-explain (zt-model-lib), zt-math-skeleton, zt-math-boundary, zt-math-proof, zt-math-theory, zt-math-check (zt-math-lib). No Event Card: the event layer is the economics set's. zt-bridge v3.
preflight.P7: Checks: as the base; the boundary review job checks each supplied counterexample; the proof review checks every step; math-check reports M1-M18. Bridge BR1–BR9, exact report acceptance and guarded edits.
preflight.P8: Failure policy: a failed index, docs, or skeleton step halts the run; a failed notation table is logged and the digest goes on. Switches: models, notation, boundary, proof, theory. Modes: the base modes plus models, explain, math. Bridge failure is nonfatal in full; bridge apply runs only args, Bridge and report.
preflight.P9: Dry run: zt-math-digest.sim.json. Fixture: tests/framework-harness.mjs runs all checks of the removed math-workflow-harness.mjs on the built script (2.3.0: base 2.2.0, the ported scripts run as zt-digest tools; 2.4.0: base 2.3.0, every digest script runs as its zt-digest tool, math-compiler as zt-digest math; 2.6.0: base 2.5.0, one whole-book card cycle instead of a cycle per block), and checks that the shared stages build the same commands in both book types. Pilot: one chapter after a database backup. bridge-workflow-harness.mjs and Bridge scratch tests; verify frozen installation and real report-only pilot separately.

supply.description: what DeepSeek may add that the book does not give (default examples)

unitsPerJob.description: units per boundary or proof job (default 4)

coreBudget.description: core parts per unit (default 3; read by the architect's math supplement)

notation.description: mode full: false skips the Book notation table

after-prepare.title: Prepare
after-prepare.detail: math-compiler.ps1: the statement index, the math prompt files, the unit and Theory Card skeleton; one DeepSeek job writes the Book notation table

after-link.title: Theory
after-link.detail: each Theory Card: question, main results, objects (DeepSeek); dependency order, tools, map (script)

after-audit.title: Audit
after-audit.detail: math-compiler.ps1 check: rules M1 to M18 on every unit and Theory Card

after-digest.title: Models
after-digest.detail: the model layer: the model compiler on every Model Card of the book (DeepSeek brief → Sonnet plan → DeepSeek fill, derive, review, split)

after-digest.title: Models
after-digest.detail: mode explain: 思路, 说明, and 解读 for finished Derivation parts

after-digest.title: Boundary
after-digest.detail: hypothesis roles, counterexamples, and contrast pairs (DeepSeek JSON, a second job checks each supplied one)

after-digest.title: Proof
after-digest.detail: a DeepSeek reviewer checks every proof plan, proof step, and conclusion
